lines.text: I am a chubby cat, happy and bright.
I love my yummy food, every single bite.
Yum, yum, fish and chicken, milk so sweet.
Eating is my favorite treat.
But I love to jump.
I love to play.
I am getting stronger every single day.
Let's go! One, two, three, look at me.
Happy cat, as you can see.
Four, five, six, watch my tricks.
Healthy power in the mix.
Clap your hands and stretch so high.
We can jump into the sky.
Meow! Oh, I see a big ball.
I see a high tree.
No time to sit, just look at me.
Healthy food gives me power and might.
I will dance and zoom from morning till night.
Left paw, right paw, step by step.
Look at me, I've got some pep.
Yeah! One, two, three, look at me.
Happy cat, as you can see.
Four, five, six, watch my tricks.
Healthy power in the mix.
Clap your hands and stretch so high.
We can jump into the sky.
Meow! Meow, meow, meow, I'm feeling good.
The happiest cat in the neighborhood.
Strong and chubby, full of play.
Have a super-duper day.
Meow! Meow!
